question: What heat, ammunition, rate of fire, reload and automatic replenish values does the vehicle registry store for each vehicle weapon, and what sustained-fire limits would follow from them?

sourceFacts.method: Every named value row of Common/GameSetup/Tweakables/GameRemixer/GRX_Vehicles was listed with the file offset of its default. Rows of weapon owners whose name ends in a heat, ammunition, rate of fire or reload property were selected and read back from the raw file at their offsets. Rows are registry defaults; own asset values are in L3307. The sustained-fire figures in the topic page are arithmetic on stored defaults and are labelled as inference.

control.description: First six selected rows, read back at their stored offsets.

inference: If heat runs from 0 to 1 and each shot adds HeatPerBullet, a weapon overheats after 1 / HeatPerBullet shots of continuous fire, less the cooling during the burst; this scale is assumed, not stored.
If heat falls by HeatDropPerSecond per second, a full cool-down takes 1 / HeatDropPerSecond seconds after any stored delay.

OverHeatThreshold stores 0.01 or 0.1 for most owners, which reads as the heat level at which an overheated weapon can fire again rather than the level at which it overheats; this reading is from the value alone.
unresolved: Heat scale and what OverHeatThreshold means. Test: hold fire with the tank coaxial heavy machine gun and count shots to overheat (20 if the scale is 0 to 1 with no cooling during fire), then time the lock-out and the return to zero heat (2 s at 0.5 per second).
Whether a match uses these defaults or the weapon assets' own values.
Meaning of AutoReplenishRounds -1 and of AutoReplenishDelay. Test: empty a vehicle weapon's reserve and time each returning round or magazine.
Rate of fire unit. Test: count shots in a 5 s burst of the scout helicopter GAU-19 from a recording.
Effect of the Enhanced Loading upgrade's heat rows (heat drop multiplier 1.3, overheated drop multiplier 1.1) on these figures.
Rows whose default is boxed or unreadable are listed in the dataset as not offset-checked.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Vehicle weapon heat, ammunition, reload and replenish rows in the vehicle registry
leads.summary: 701 vehicle registry rows store weapon heat, ammunition, rate of fire, reload and automatic replenish values; 16 owners have heat rows (tank coaxial heavy machine gun 0.05 per bullet, 0.5 drop per second). Sustained-fire figures derived from them are inference. 701 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game shots-to-overheat, cool-down or replenish timing, or a game update that changes a row.
leads.statusNote: Registry defaults only; heat scale, units and runtime use unconfirmed; derived figures are inference.

assets.question: What heat, ammunition, rate of fire, reload and automatic replenish values does the vehicle registry store for each vehicle weapon, and what sustained-fire limits would follow from them?
assets.conclusion: Heat rows exist for 16 weapon owners, for example the tank coaxial heavy machine gun (heat per bullet 0.05, heat drop per second 0.5), the anti-air high velocity gun (0.036, 0.5) and the scout helicopter GAU-19 (0.03125, 0.3). Ammunition rows (magazine capacity, magazines, auto replenish magazine, rounds and delay) exist for 55 owners, with rate of fire and reload rows beside them.
